spanish: Y también a Elneatán y a Delajahu y a Gemarjahu se les dio orden de no quemar la hoja, pero no le hicieron caso.

findings.issue: reverses participants and action: Hebrew has the three men interceding with the king not to burn; Spanish says an order was given to the three
findings.spanishSpan: se les dio orden de no quemar

findings.issue: wrong subject for 'not listen': Hebrew has the king not listening to them; Spanish has the three not heeding
megillah rendered as 'hoja' (leaf) instead of scroll/roll
